name: stella-folio
description: Open .docx files in VS Code and edit them on laid-out pages: type, track changes, comment, and save back to the same file. Also gives agent mode folio's .docx tools over MCP.
author: STLL

folio.author.markdownDescription: Name recorded on every tracked change, comment, and reply, by the `.docx` editor and by the MCP server. When empty, the editor uses `git config user.name`, then your OS account name; the server uses `FOLIO_AUTHOR`, then `git config user.name`, and refuses changes if neither is set.

enumDescriptions: Edits are recorded as tracked changes.
folio.editor.trackChanges.markdownDescription: How the `.docx` editor starts: `off` edits the document directly, `on` records every edit as a tracked change. The editor's toolbar switches between them at any time.

folio.editor.confirmRewrite.markdownDescription: Ask once per session before a save rewrites the whole document package instead of only the paragraphs you changed. The previous version is backed up in `.folio/backups/` either way.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The editor works in untrusted workspaces. The MCP server, which can change files, is offered only once the workspace is trusted.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The editor opens files on a virtual file system read-only (Save As still works). The MCP server needs workspace folders on disk.
